title: DocumentCodeRaisedPayload
description: Payload of the DocumentCodeRaised event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml; class: domain; INV-REQ-79). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4). An optional member is absent when the catalogue gives none and is never guessed by the consumer.

entityRef.description: The entity the document belongs to (INV-REQ-79).

periodRef.description: The filing period of the document (INV-REQ-79).

code.description: The error-catalogue code raised on the document (INV-REQ-79).

remediationOwner.description: The effective owner of the code in the error catalogue (INV-REQ-79). Absent when the catalogue gives none; never guessed by the consumer.

disposition.description: The base disposition of the code in the error catalogue: AUTO_RELEASE, AUTO_RETRY, MANUAL, OVERRIDABLE, TERMINAL; extensible (INV-REQ-79). Absent when the catalogue gives none; never guessed by the consumer.
